posts.title: Blood Moon Pact - Review Pt. 1 - Player
posts.description: The Preamble Blood Moon Pact is a Jubensha (a form of immersive, scripted, murder mystery roleplaying game originating in China) for 6 players. It's a bit like a murder mystery party if the emphasis was placed more on a compelling story and high emotional stakes , instead of campy roleplaying and "escape room" like puzzle solving (which is also very fun, don't get me wrong). Set in a dark fantasy
